/* TimeSaleSmpBensonMapper.getTimeSaleSmpBensonList */
SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(tsdpst.SALE_DATE, 'yyyymmdd'), 'yyyy-mm-dd') AS SALE_DATE, tsdpst.SALE_HOUR, tsdpst.STORE_CD, tms.STORE_NM, tmp.PROD_NM, SUM(tsdpst.TOT_SALE_QTY) AS SALE_QTY1, SUM(tsdpst.TOT_SALE_AMT) AS TOT_SALE_AMT1, SUM(tsdpst.REAL_SALE_AMT) AS REAL_SALE_AMT1
FROM TB_SL_DAILY_PROD_SDSEL_DLVR_TIME_MOMS_V04 tsdpst, TB_MS_STORE tms, TB_MS_STORE_INFO tmsi, TB_MS_PRODUCT tmp WHERE 1=1 AND tsdpst.HQ_OFFICE_CD = #{hqOfficeCd} AND tsdpst.SALE_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND tsdpst.STORE_CD IN (${storeCdQuery})
AND tsdpst.DLVR_ORDER_FG IN
#{item}
AND tms.HQ_BRAND_CD = #{storeHqBrandCd} -- 매장브랜드 선택일때
-- 매장브랜드 전체일때 AND tms.HQ_BRAND_CD IN
#{item}
AND tmp.PROD_CLASS_CD IN ( SELECT PROD_CLASS_CD FROM TB_MS_PRODUCT_CLASS WHERE STORE_CD = tmp.STORE_CD START WITH PROD_CLASS_CD = #{prodClassCd} AND STORE_CD = tmp.STORE_CD CONNECT BY PRIOR PROD_CLASS_CD = P_PROD_CLASS_CD AND STORE_CD = tmp.STORE_CD )
AND tmp.PROD_CD LIKE '%'||#{prodCd}||'%'
AND tmp.PROD_NM LIKE '%'||#{prodNm}||'%'
AND tmp.PROD_CD IN (${prodCdQuery})
AND tmp.HQ_BRAND_CD = #{prodHqBrandCd} -- 상품브랜드 선택일때
-- 상품브랜드 전체일때 AND tmp.HQ_BRAND_CD IN
#{item}
AND tms.STORE_CD = tsdpst.STORE_CD AND tmsi.STORE_CD (+)= tms.STORE_CD AND tmp.STORE_CD = tsdpst.STORE_CD AND tmp.PROD_CD = tsdpst.PROD_CD GROUP BY tsdpst.SALE_DATE, tsdpst.SALE_HOUR, tsdpst.STORE_CD, tms.STORE_NM, tsdpst.PROD_CD, tmp.PROD_NM ORDER BY tsdpst.SALE_DATE, tsdpst.SALE_HOUR, tsdpst.STORE_CD, tsdpst.PROD_CD
